title: Pokémon TCG Drampa Scarlet & Violet-Temporal Forces 138/162 Holo Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon TCG card is a must-have addition to any collector's deck. The card features the powerful Drampa attack, with a colorless attribute and a basic stage. It is part of the Scarlet & Violet-Temporal Forces set, with a card number of 138/162 and a rare finish.

The card has a holographic design that adds an extra touch of rarity and uniqueness. It is perfect for players and collectors alike who are looking to expand their collection with a valuable and rare card. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this card to your deck today!
